**Orbweaver 1.0.13 adds an anonymous, opt-out install count so we can see how many people use Orbweaver, and fixes cloud replies that never appeared, a peer link that stopped accepting, and a free-text answer that could reach a closed form.**

## What's new

- **Anonymous install count, on by default and easy to turn off.** Once a day, alongside the update check, Orbweaver sends one small event: the app version, OS, CPU architecture and a random install ID that is created on this machine and tied to nothing else. No IP-based location is stored, and no names, paths, sessions, prompts or account details are sent. Turn it off in Settings → Updates → "Share an anonymous install count", or set `ORBWEAVER_INSTALL_PING=0` or `DO_NOT_TRACK=1`. Turning it off deletes the install ID. It never runs when automatic update checks are off. (CB-466)
- **A new README front page** with a short pitch, a website link and illustrations of the orbs at work. (CB-466)
- **Paperclip bug-fix org package.** A ready-made Paperclip company that picks up CB bugs, with its warden and setup notes, ships alongside the triage org. (CB-455)

## Fixes

- **Cloud replies that never appeared.** If a trusted cloud stream went quiet right after your message echoed, Orbweaver now goes back to polling, so the reply shows up. (CB-345)
- **Peer link stopped accepting connections.** A single accept error used to end the peer listener until restart. It now keeps listening. (CB-343)
- **Free-text answers to a closed form.** Each arrow key in a free-text answer now re-reads the form first, so a keystroke can't land after the form has closed. (CB-405)
- Test suite reliability on Windows CI and in parallel runs. (CB-378, CB-410)

## Upgrading

- Install 1.0.13 from the update notice, or by hand as usual.
- **macOS:** if your other machines, OpenClaw, Paperclip or the phone relay stop connecting after the upgrade, re-grant Local Network in **System Settings → Privacy & Security**.
